refused: The scratches fall into the Voyd.
quiet: The vault grows quiet. These scratches may be offered again after a watch.
unknownLeaf: No such leaf was pressed in these stacks.
timestream: This leaf lies in a timestream you have not walked.
issued: The stacks cut six marks. They are the only key to this desk. Write them where your eyes can find them.
slipRefused: That shorter scratching does not take.
bound: The separate scratchings are bound into one.
needShort: A shorter scratching is four or five claw-marks.
needTwo: Set two scratchings the stacks already know.
seekEmpty: Nothing you may touch answers that.
version: These marks belong to a script the stacks do not keep.
unheard: The stacks did not hear that.
miss: No such leaf was pressed in these stacks.
